The converse by flat descent (proof lines 6462-6470).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the property P(S) = 'S is Gorenstein' is local in the syntomic topology (statement lines 6435-6454). For a syntomic covering {S_i -> S}, the proof first notes that S is locally Noetherian if and only if each S_i is, by Descent, Lemma labelled descent-lemma-Noetherian-local-fppf, so one may assume all the schemes locally Noetherian (proof lines 6456-6462). If S is Gorenstein then each S_i is Gorenstein by Lemma labelled lemma-gorenstein-lci; conversely, if every S_i is Gorenstein, then for a point s of S one picks i and t in S_i mapping to s, so that O_{S,s} -> O_{S_i,t} is a flat local ring homomorphism with Gorenstein target, and Dualizing Complexes, Lemma labelled dualizing-lemma-flat-under-gorenstein makes O_{S,s} Gorenstein (proof lines 6462-6470). Reducing to the locally Noetherian case and then descending Gorensteinness along a flat local homomorphism is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
